acceptance: An owner-approved decision record exists before any implementation, or the item is dropped with the measurement as the reason.
context:
2026-10-26: owner decision Q4: local findings, rebuttals and dispositions carry into CI as claims only (oracle-local-findings-record-disputes-20261026); a local result never counts towards oracle-gate. This item's question (a signed pre-submission verdict that counts) remains open and unchanged.

Re-homed from the deferred signed-verdict option of the 2026-10-25 proposal.
description:
Deferred from the 2026-10-25 oracle proposal (second Advisor review, option b1). A trusted service on the gateway host could review an exact patch before a PR exists and sign a verdict bound to the patch digest and file list; oracle-gate would then accept it the way it accepts a stand-in attestation for an exact head. That changes what the required gate trusts and adds an always-on, authenticated service on a home machine.

Decision gate: consider only if, 30 days after oracle-local-prepr-review-20261025 lands, NO-SHIP or SHIP WITH FIXES round trips on opened PRs remain the main cause of merge latency. Record the measurement, then write a decision record and get the owner's approval before any build.

Guardrails: no change to oracle-gate's trust without that decision record and owner approval; a verdict must bind to the exact patch digest and file list; an asleep host means pending, never a pass.
